verdict.rationale: Rippling documents a public developer platform: APIs for building custom apps across HR, IT, and finance, developer docs with a sandbox, an llms.txt, and an official CLI for deploying Rippling-hosted integrations. Nothing in the evidence shows the API matches the UI, and most documented features (payroll runs, benefits enrollment, time tracking, approvals) are described only as UI or platform capabilities. Missing for 10: evidence of API coverage for core UI actions such as running payroll, benefits changes and approvals; documented UI/API parity; independent hands-on confirmation of API breadth.
